title: Symphony tote

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Test the identity in everyday use because a portable object can extend recognition beyond the venue.
strategic_value: A simple white signature on a dark tote can connect a casual encounter with the Symphony.
demonstration: A walking person carries a dark tote with the white Symphony wordmark near its upper edge.
practical_value: Choose how much identity is needed when the object has limited space and moves with its user.
